role: Prospective test on one project-unseen survey after observing Stratton/Volve results; two known surveys remain descriptive replication

holdout.attribution: Jorge Leonardo, compilation; Chevron U.S.A. Inc., SEG 2020 workshop; New Zealand Petroleum and Minerals, original Parihaka survey
holdout.license: CC BY 4.0 for the published compilation; preserve original-provider credit
holdout.axis_rule: The unique axis of length 1006 is time; move it first and preserve the order of the other two file axes. Require remaining axis lengths 590 and 782. No physical-coordinate interpretation.
holdout.amplitude_scope: Publisher-organized standardized numeric volume; uncalibrated digital amplitudes, not original SEG-Y trace bytes

selection_rule: Same six disjoint complete rank blocks as the prior spatial protocol; no amplitude-based replacement or silent skips
random_search: Common Jitter start plus 299 uniformly drawn fixed-cardinality eligible masks. NumPy SeedSequence([seed, count, hidden-set ordinal, 20261104]); duplicate proposals count. Native objective scores every proposal once. Choose minimum objective only, earliest proposal on ties.
dictionary: Unchanged 64 finite 2D Fourier atoms, kx,ky in 0..7, on the 16x16 rank grid

primary.endpoint: SNR on the 32 common hidden positions; average windows, hidden sets and seeds within block, then equal-weight six block means
primary.consistency_criterion: Report whether all six block means are positive for each comparison; a descriptive consistency criterion, not a population significance test
primary.no_retuning: No outcome-dependent changes to windows, masks, recovery controls or endpoint; negative and null results retained

secondary: Counts 76 and 179, both known surveys, full-spatial-FFT coherence and objective/recovery mismatch diagnostics; descriptive only
scope: 2592 recovery cases, 36 space-time cubes, 18 correlated physical/rank blocks, one newly accessed survey. No original-SPS waveform, calibrated amplitude, migration or actual field-cost claim. Objective evaluation counts are not wall-clock or acquisition-cost equivalence.
